text.tspan: Pivot 3 locked at idx 2! Left [2, 1] <= 3, Right [6, 5, 4] > 3

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Lomuto partition takes linear Theta(n) time and 0 extra memory. Pivot 3 is now permanently sorted at index 2.
Next: recursively partition the left sub-array [2, 1] and the right sub-array [6, 5, 4].

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Lomuto partitioning scans array, gathers items <= pivot to the left, and locks the pivot in place.
